mapper.sql: select tool_id, tool_name, tool_url, tool_desc, sort_order, enabled, dept_id, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from biz_student_tool
mapper.insert:
insert into biz_student_tool
tool_name, tool_url, tool_desc, sort_order, enabled, dept_id, create_by, remark, create_time

mapper.delete: delete from biz_student_tool where tool_id in #{toolId}
mapper.select: select distinct t.tool_id, t.tool_name, t.tool_url, t.tool_desc, t.sort_order, t.enabled, t.dept_id from biz_student_tool t join biz_student_tool_scope s on s.tool_id = t.tool_id where t.enabled = 1 and (t.dept_id = #{deptId} or t.dept_id is null) and s.entry_year = #{entryYear} and (s.class_code = #{classCode} or s.class_code is null or s.class_code = '') order by t.sort_order asc, t.tool_id asc
mapper.insert: insert into biz_student_tool_scope (tool_id, entry_year, class_code) values (#{toolId}, #{entryYear}, #{classCode})

mapper.update: update biz_lesson_tool set tool_name = #{toolName}, tool_url = #{toolUrl}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where tool_id = #{toolId}
